title: Heinkel Childhood
text:
Wilhelm apparently had a doting side towards Heinkel, in one instance, when a little Heinkel was swinging a tool designed to prune branches (something that looked like a nata - sort of like a machete), Wilhelm would keep saying his kid had great talent for the sword, and that he'd become the Sword Saint.

Meanwhile, Theresia would scold Wilhelm for saying these things and tell him that kids shouldn't be carrying dangerous things like that.

Meanwhile, Heinkel would get pumped up saying "I'm a Sword Saint too!"
